title: Enter submits a half finished slash command that needs an argument
instruction: In the prompt editor, when I type /mcp test and the suggestion list is open, pressing Enter sends the command at once and the handler then rejects it because the name is missing. I want Enter to continue into the argument for subcommands that cannot run without one, and to behave as before for the others.
acceptance_criteria: Enter on a fully typed subcommand that needs an argument accepts the suggestion and leaves the editor at the argument.
Other subcommands still submit on Enter.
